items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Piano Gibson to Paul Oliver' as a potential confusion or reference point, but the interviewee never mentions Paul Oliver, nor does he confirm any relationship with him. The interviewee only discusses P.R. Gibson.

ctx.x: You've got to be a man.
Uh, you mentioned, uh, Piano Gibson to Paul Oliver. Could you tell me more about that? Oh, you mean Piano Gibson? Uh, Piano Gibson, Loomis Gibson, he played on Beatles Street and Memphis.

Oh, no, they got the wrong name. His name is P. R. Gibson. And, brother, do you know P. R. Gibson? Yes. That's a bad man. His mother graduated him, uh, at, he went to school and, uh, he wasn't, because people didn't get the education.
